scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @casepilot/functions && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-casepilot --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,tasks
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-casepilot --only firestore "npm run test:emulator -w @casepilot/rules-tests"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @casepilot/functions && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-casepilot --only auth,firestore,functions,storage,tasks "npm run test:emulator -w @casepilot/integration-tests"
